strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
So this is the inside of the battleship... Didn't expect this.
This is no ordinary battleship... Kappei! Be careful, okay!?
Leave it to me! We're in the enemy's belly, so if we just go wild...
You have come... descendants of the Jin family.
What!? Where's that coming from!
Tch, over there... So you're the Gaizok!
Indeed... I am... the god of the Gaizok...
God...?
The time has come... to destroy you once again...
Once again...!? Then you were the one who... our ancestors...!?
...Indeed. Your distant ancestors, who harbored evil thoughts...
It was I... who destroyed them...
Screw you! And what do you mean, you're a god!
If you can reach me... and defeat me...
you shall understand its meaning... If you can defeat me...
Oh yeah! Bring it on! Don't you move from that spot!
Keiko! Are reinforcements coming or not!
The jamming's too strong to confirm. ...I think they're catching up, but...
Did we get in too deep!? Tch...!
Heh, so they might not come!? Then we'll just do it ourselves!
...Dangerous... Just as they feared... you are meant to perish...
The Nadesico Super Express has arrived!
Geez! Steering the ship was pretty tough,
so I wish you wouldn't say it so casually.
This is the inside of a battleship? It's like a maze...
Oh! Londo Bell!? Quattro, over here!
You three seem unharmed.
Aw, you could've come after we'd smashed the Gaizok.
These guys aren't worth saving.
If you were in the same spot, Ryoko, I bet you'd say the same thing.
This is no time to dawdle! I'm heading out!
All units, sortie!
That's... the Gaizok...!?
Seems so. ...What a hideous form.
I don't wanna hear a monster like that lecture us about fighting!
Yeah, I'm gonna smash it for sure!
I don't think it's wise to judge by appearances.
...Appearance and the meaning of words need not match.
Captain?
Then you mean what that Butcher said before wasn't wrong?
Sorry to interrupt, but enemy reinforcements incoming.
So they were stockpiling forces after all...! Stay alert, everyone!
There's a lot of 'em. Is the Princess outside gonna be okay!?
Let's wrap this up fast!
All... for the sake... of...
Trying to overwhelm us with numbers now is pointless!
Quality over quantity!
Here we go...!
...This power... Is this... what you... sought...?
Huh...? The power... we sought...?
Quit talking nonsense! Keiko, don't let it get to you!
That's right. With this many of 'em, get distracted and you lose...!
But then... why... did they choose that land... as the beginning...
(The land of... beginnings? It isn't speaking to us...?)
...Hm...!? What is this...!?
Kamille?
...No, I have a bad feeling... like a sense of foreboding...
Bad feeling? C'mon, cut it out...
...Looks like you nailed it. Energy readings rising.
...You who guard me and rule death... when one who defiles the Bandock
appears... you shall rise again...
Tch, there's still this many!?
This... looks like it'll be back-breaking work.
So this was your bad feeling! ...Yeah, that's a few too many...!
Like I'm scared of numbers now! We won't lose!
Right, right! At times like this, it's all about guts! Guts!
That's pure spirit talk, but it looks like it's all we've got.
It's the Gaizok's last struggle. Let's push through, Kappei!
Yeah! I'll smash 'em!
(Our morale holds... What concerns me is the Gaizok's true intent.)
Mu... uuuuoooooh...!
Is it... over!?
Heh heh... Looks like it ain't a dream...?
We did it... We beat it...! We finally beat the Gaizok!
...That voice... You are Kappei... Jin...?
Huh...? S-Still...!?
...I... am defeated. ...People of Earth.
The Gaizok's true form... You're the Gaizok, aren't you!?
We won!
Now we'll avenge our ancestors!
Gaizok... no... I was built by the Gaizok aliens...
I am merely... Computer Doll No. 8...
What... do you mean by that!?
So it's not the enemy boss!?
This thing is just a pawn of the Gaizok...!?
...Yes. I was built... to react to living beings with evil thoughts.
Long ago, I... your ancestors' planet... Planet Bial...
I destroyed, for it was overflowing with malice...
Y-You're lying...? You... You're not the Gaizok!?
Calm down, Kappei!
...Tch, the enemy's home base... Planet Gaizok, was it?
So we've got no choice but to storm the place ourselves!?
...That would be... pointless.
Screw that! You don't know till you try...
...The Gaizok who built me... have already... perished...
What!?
...A robot that just... keeps on watching.
Its mechanism never died... so probably, all this time, out in space...
Huh... What does that mean!?
This is only speculation... but however advanced it may be,
a machine can do nothing but run the program it's been given...
Something programmed only to identify enemies and fight...
...is what we've been calling the Gaizok...!?
And so... I entered two hundred years of peaceful slumber...
But once again... a planet overflowing with evil thoughts...
awoke me from my peace...
And that's... Earth...!?
Are you saying everyone on Earth is a bad person!?
...Hating one another... lying to one another... selfish thoughts...
and worse, creatures that kill their own kind... cannot be called good...
Their own kind... killing each other...?
...Who can say.
(Captain...?)
...Those who destroy... the quiet peace of space... I was built
by the Gaizok... to sweep away... such creatures...
Destroying the peace of space...!? Us!?
That's not true! Everyone's a good person!
Kappei...
The enemy mothership... meaning here... Heat in its core is rising.
Huh!? What does that mean!?
To put it bluntly, it's going to explode.
Huh!? Wh-Whyyy!?
I've confirmed it here too. ...We did go pretty wild.
And besides... the core... probably the engine block, I think...
at this rate, it'll soon...
...Right, we're getting out! All units, maximum combat speed...
Enemy reinforcements.
Wh-Why now of all times!? It's gonna explode, y'know!
Tch, we took down the boss and they still keep coming!
Big Bro! Th-That's...!
That thing... The one that showed up right before we entered the planet!?
Why's it here!
The Einst leader. What could it be after...
Jaburo, then before Planet Dirad... How many of these are there!?
But open space is one thing... why inside this battleship!?
Is there some other way in?
Didn't it come in through the hole we made!?
There were no readings. ...It seems it was here from the start.
...It may be a robot meant to defend a stronghold.
A stronghold...? You mean the Gaizok battleship!?
A hunch.
...But in the end, the Gaizok were nothing but a relic of the past.
In other words, this is the Gaizok's heart.
So... this means the Gaizok threat is gone, right?
And that's when it appeared...
On the ground... it was when we liberated Jaburo.
In space, right before we entered Planet Dirad... Big turning points...!
...The Gaizok and the mystery enemy... If they shared a goal...
or if they had something in common...
Cryptic as always, Captain! If you figured something out, explain it!
No, they won't give us time to reach a conclusion... Here they come!
(But... that wouldn't explain Excellen and Kyosuke...)
Damn it! Were the Gaizok and the mystery enemy working together!?
Isn't this ever gonna end!
What's this about disturbing the peace of space!
Gaizok computer jerk, if you wanna destroy something,
go after guys like these!
...It was full. Planet Gaizok too... of malice.
But... I cannot... destroy... my creators...
Wh-What!? That Gaizok bastard's still alive...
It cannot... destroy its creators...?
...Then why did the Gaizok perish...? With technology this advanced.
Don't tell me...
Explain yourself, Gaizok!
...My systems... are too badly damaged...
Answer me!
Damn it... What the hell...
Kappei... We're fighting for peace, for everyone, right?
There's nothing to be unsure about.
(If what I'm thinking is right...
then most likely, what destroyed Planet Gaizok was...!)
No time for brooding, it seems. The enemy looks raring to go.
...How much time!?
Estimated time to critical explosion... 5 minutes.
Five minutes!?
S-Seriously, Ruri?
Seriously.
All-out attack to bring down that big one! Then we break out in one go!
We have no choice. Let's go.
1. Destroy Einst Regisseur.
1. All allies are destroyed. 2. Victory conditions are not met within 5 turns of the Einst Regisseur appearing.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Got it!
Everyone who can return, land on the ship right away!
Escaaape!
...The Gaizok... Is it... finally over...?
